author: KroestV2
body:
Right now here are like 3-4 objectives on a lot of maps in the rotation. Most objectives get farmed, are hard to defend, and if you defend, the chance of your teammate to also defend the 1 out of the 4 possible objectives is small. By decreasing the amount of objectives you increase the chances of players defending a monument, and it will be more of a challange to complete an objective.

Another issue on a lot of maps is that people that spawn, don't see where their own objective is located. The objectives are often located behind spawn, so players cannot see the objective on their way to the midline, and the chances of players defending or spotting the opponent breaking the monument are very small.

replies.author: KroestV2
replies.body: You can't compare competitive with public gameplay. During a scrim all teammates can communicate with eachother and teams have dedicated skilled players as defenders. The can call out when someone is rushing an objective, and can help the defender when the opponent is team pushing. On a 20v20 - 30v30 match like 10% of the team defends. These defenders are usually not as good, and cannot rely on any communication with the midline. I have never seen a match where all 4 objectives get defended at the same time with these playercounts.
